newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nikka Whisky shares up on firm earnings forecast.
newsitem.headline: Nikka Whisky shares up on firm earnings forecast.

text.p: Shares in Nikka Whisky Distilling Co Ltd climbed on Friday morning, boosted by the company's firm earnings forecast announced on Thursday, traders said.
At 0047 GMT, Nikka's shares were up 34 yen at 849 yen in turnover of 161,000.
Nikka was ranked as the second largest percentage gainer on the second section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
The firm said on Thursday that it expected parent current profits to hit 800 million yen in the financial year to December 31, 1997, compared with 786 million yen in the previous year.
